scope: label-free counterfactual and frequency-aligned scene representation on development folds 3 and 4 only

representation.teacher: released MARS-S2L U-Net frozen by checkpoint SHA-256

frequency_alignment.method: replace the centered low-frequency Fourier amplitude box of one date with its paired date while retaining source phase
frequency_alignment.application: 64x64 pooled six-band reflectance tensors in both temporal directions
frequency_alignment.research_basis: FeaSpect, CVPR 2025; fixed physical input transform only, not a claim to reproduce its trainable latent module

representation.highpass: 9x9 local-mean removal on pooled temporal differences
representation.label_use: none in image transforms or frozen-teacher inference; labels are copied to ignored metadata for later fold-restricted evaluation

runtime.autocast: float16 teacher; float32 counterfactual and Fourier transforms

invariants: Only development folds 3 and 4 are eligible for this extraction.
The three controls are derived from each scene itself and require no new label.
The same frozen released U-Net scores all four temporal views.
No fold 0/1/2, exact-paper, or fresh-external image or label may be loaded.
Bulk image and metadata caches remain Git-ignored; only the compact receipt is committed.
A later ranker must compare against the already frozen spatial-Prithvi score, not an earlier weaker head.
